# TrackMyRead

> Track your reading progress, share highlights, and discover books with friends. Free book tracker app for web and Android.

TrackMyRead is a free social book tracking platform for readers. Users track reading progress page by page, write highlights and notes, follow friends, and join reading circles (groups). It is a modern, social alternative to Goodreads.

## Key Features

- Page-by-page reading progress tracking with automatic reading speed calculation
- Reading log and history with dates, star ratings, highlights, and personal notes
- Social reading feed — follow friends, see what they are reading, share highlights
- Reading circles (groups) — shared reading goals, chapter discussions, monthly challenges
- Yearly reading insights — pages read, books finished, reading streaks
- Import Goodreads library in one click
- Available free on web and Android

## Platform

- Web app: https://www.trackmyread.com
- Android app: available on Google Play Store
- 12,000+ active readers
